races.paceDynamic: Lady Dora Mae is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will face no early pressure from the gate, allowing her to dictate terms through moderate fractions. Handle With Care and Cool Molly may track her from prominent positions, but the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses including Madame De Sevigne, Lady Manzor, Mereside Diva, and So Sassy who will settle towards the rear. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can control the tempo before the field bunches up in the final two furlongs. This setup strongly favours prominent runners and pace-setters — the sustainable gallop will not string out the field sufficiently to aid closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae maintains her recent form and controls the pace uncontested.
scenarios.body: The Boughey filly can dictate ideal fractions and has the tactical speed to kick clear when challenged, with her two recent wins proving her effectiveness at this trip. Handle With Care can track her throughout and benefit from the honest gallop, while most hold-up horses will find insufficient pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Handle With Care or Cool Molly can sit second or third and time their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: These prominent runners can stalk the leaders without doing the donkey work, then use their superior speed ratings to strike in the final furlong. The moderate pace will keep them close enough to pounce when Lady Dora Mae comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in the final quarter-mile and the field compacts dramatically.
scenarios.body: Madame De Sevigne and Lady Manzor could benefit from a bunched finish if their class tells, but they need the leaders to stop significantly. The lack of early pace makes this scenario less likely but not impossible with their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and an unconsidered runner finds the perfect trip.
scenarios.body: Dandy Khan or Searchingtheblues could sneak through if the pace truly collapses, but both need significant help from race dynamics. Their moderate recent form suggests they need everything to fall perfectly to trouble the principals.

watchPoints.text: Lady Dora Mae getting an easy lead through slow early fractions will make her very hard to peg back in the straight
Handle With Care and Cool Molly's ability to sit handy without doing early work could be crucial given the lack of pace pressure

The 5lb claimers on Lady Dora Mae, Lady Manzor, and Party Bear getting valuable weight relief in a competitive handicap

races.paceDynamic: St Faz will lead or sit prominent from the start, setting a steady but sustainable gallop over this 2-mile trip. With most of the field preferring to sit off the pace (9 of 14 runners styled as hold-up), there's limited early pressure on the leaders. Shrimp Shady, Circuit Breaker and Diamond Bay will track behind St Faz in the early stages, but the bulk of the field will be held up in the rear half. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine but not frantic, allowing closers to wind up from the back and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate through the middle stages with St Faz and the prominently-raced horses setting a steady tempo.
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup to unleash late runs, with Appier and Charlie's Choice having the class and recent form to capitalize. Their styles are perfectly suited to pick off tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Control
scenarios.trigger: If Shrimp Shady or Circuit Breaker press St Faz early, creating stronger fractions that stretch the field.
scenarios.body: The increased pace plays into the hands of horses racing closer to the speed, with Shrimp Shady's Balding training and Circuit Breaker's recent improved form putting them in prime position. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightweight Challenger Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Arc Zoosve's 14-pound weight advantage proves decisive in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: Despite his low rating, Arc Zoosve's recent win and significant weight pull allows him to outfinish higher-rated rivals who are carrying more burden. His hold-up style gets the perfect race setup to exploit the weight differential.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front End Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If St Faz gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up horses fail to organize their challenges effectively.
scenarios.body: With such a large field sitting off the pace, the closers may get in each other's way or leave their runs too late, allowing St Faz to maintain his advantage. His recent hat-trick of wins shows he's in peak form and capable of lasting home.

The bulk of the field (eight hold-up horses) will settle behind this modest early gallop before unleashing their finishing kicks. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to string out the field but not punishing enough to stop the closers.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: My Fermoy is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate from the flag without pressure early, creating a measured gallop. scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Robusto is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the outset, likely setting a steady rhythm without pressure from the predominantly hold-up field. Bystander and The Bay Warrior may track prominently but the vast majority of this 16-runner field prefer to be held up, creating a bunched group behind the leaders. The sustainable early pace combined with a large field of closers will create a traffic-laden sprint finish where positioning and a clear run will be crucial. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can find gaps in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field stays bunched into the straight
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will fan out wide in the final quarter-mile, with the best-handicapped and most progressive types prevailing. Horses with recent winning form and strong finishing kicks will have every chance to demonstrate their class.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto gets an uncontested lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The front runner and prominent racers will have stolen crucial lengths, making the task impossible for the closers despite their superior ratings. Early positioning becomes the decisive factor in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the home straight
scenarios.body: Several hold-up horses with winning chances will find themselves trapped behind faltering leaders, allowing those with clearer passages to capitalize. The winner will be determined more by luck in running than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Front Runner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed hold-up horses goes forward to pressure Robusto early
scenarios.body: The unexpected pace pressure creates a genuinely run race that stretches the field, favoring horses with proven stamina at this trip. The tactical change catches the market off guard.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the home straight with 16 runners and most preferring to be held up - several contenders will find trouble
Monitor Robusto's early pace - if he gets too easy a lead the hold-up horses may struggle to peg him back
Note the ground conditions throughout the card - any deterioration could impact the closing efforts of the hold-up brigade
Watch for market support for Wonder and Mao Shang Wong who both arrive in excellent form with strong recent wins
Observe Damascus Steel's position turning in - needs clear running room to utilize his proven finishing kick effectively
